source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The Riesz framework treats linear functionals on potential-outcome function spaces and develops necessary and sufficient consistency conditions for its estimator framework.
The paper improves computation for semilinear minimax estimation and supplies a combinatorial condition implying constant worst-case error for all estimators.
The published model uses Bernoulli randomization and a hierarchy of low-order interaction classes for neighborhood interference.
The report bounds Sherali-Adams and Lasserre exactness ranks using the treewidth of a polynomial system's canonical hypergraph.
